external_evidence: Reporter's backtrace: abort() <- AWS-LC rand_bytes_core <- RAND_bytes <- aws_lc_rs::rand::fill <- rustls SessionId::random; on aarch64 FEAT_RNG, AWS-LC uses RNDR with no retry. Reporter links upstream aws/aws-lc#3453 and states 'It's ultimately an AWS-LC bug'. Workaround OPENSSL_armcap=~0x20000.
rationale: The crash originates in AWS-LC (RNDR instruction with no retry), a dependency of rustls/aws-lc-rs, with an upstream issue already filed; the reporter acknowledges it is an AWS-LC bug. The report has backtrace, version and environment, so no MRE is needed. What is asked of uv (document the workaround, track the upstream fix, prefer getrandom, or add a config knob) is new behaviour or documentation, so enhancement rather than bug. Searches of the issue tracker found no earlier related issues; I did not search the docs for a page covering this, as TLS docs have nothing on crypto provider RNG.
